title: Reentrant value fields as delayed coupled reaction-diffusion systems on finite graphs
abstract: arXiv:2605.03940v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We describe a dynamical system in which a symbolic field is coupled to a geometric field via a bipartite Hilbert-Schmidt kernel. The system is fully described by a retarded functional differential equation (RFDE) on the history space, subject to Lipschitz and small gain conditions. We show that the RFDE is well-posed under constant input and that it admits a compact global attractor. The principal subsystem $(H_L, X_R, P)$, which is comprised of the two primary fields as well as an executive field, is shown to be globally stable independent of delay, provided that the interfield coupling satisfies $C_{\mathcal{K}}^2<\mu_L\mu_R$. In addition, we describe design specifications that fulfill the hypotheses of the main Theorem.

translated_title: 有限图上作为时滞耦合反应-扩散系统的重入值场
translated_abstract: 我们描述了一个动力系统，其中一个符号场通过一个二部希尔伯特-施密特核与一个几何场相耦合。该系统由历史空间上的一个时滞泛函微分方程（RFDE）完整刻画，并受Lipschitz条件与小增益条件的约束。我们证明了该RFDE在常值输入下是适定的，且具有一个紧的全局吸引子。主子系统 $(H_L, X_R, P)$ 由两个主要场以及一个执行场构成，我们证明了只要场间耦合满足 $C_{\mathcal{K}}^2<\mu_L\mu_R$，该子系统便具有与时滞无关的全局稳定性。此外，我们还给出了满足主要定理假设的设计规范。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过二部希尔伯特-施密特核将符号场与几何场耦合的时滞泛函微分方程动力系统，证明了其适定性、紧全局吸引子的存在性，以及主子系统在耦合强度条件满足时的时滞无关全局稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a delayed dynamical system coupling a symbolic field to a geometric field via a bipartite Hilbert-Schmidt kernel, establishing well-posedness of the RFDE, existence of a compact global attractor, and delay-independent global stability of the principal subsystem under an interfield coupling condition.
